Leadership, Composition and Organizational Structure. The Task
Force shall be headed by the Chief, Intelligence Service, Armed Forces of the Philippines,
assisted by a PNP officer who shall serve as the Deputy Task Force Commander for
Intelligence/Operations, and an NBI official who shall be designated as the Deputy Task
Force Commander for Investigation and Legal Affairs. Structurally, the Task Force shall be
organized as follows:
Directly under the Task Force Commander are the Executive Officer
and a functional staff that shall assist the Task Force Commander in

2
the implementation, supervision and orchestration of the Task Force
policies and orders within their respective functional areas.
A Task Force Operations Center (TFOC) shall be created to monitor and
orchestrate the day-to-day operational activities of the Task Force. It
shall be manned by elements from the different agencies involved.
Component force shall be organized separately to be composed of
competent and dedicated elements from the PNP, NBI, DOJ, NICA,
AFP Major Service CI Units, ISAFP and other units/agencies concerned,
as may be deemed necessary. They shall be directly under the
supervision and control of the Task Force Commander.
The national organizational setup shall be replicated or similarly
organized in the regions except the National Capital Region which shall
be placed under the jurisdiction of the NCR-based national
organization. The creation of Regional Task Groups outside NCR shall
be phased in and selectively determined according to operational
necessity. Among the regions which will be given priority after NCR are
Region 9, Region 12, the Autonomous Region for Muslim Mindanao
(ARMM), Region 7, Region 6, Region 3, and Region 4. Other regions
may follow as the need arises.
The Assistant Group Commanders of the Field Military Intelligence
Groups, ISAFP, shall act as the Regional Task Group Commander for
their respective regions.
Transportation, communications, firearms and individual equipment of
personnel of the component forces shall be provided by their respective
mother agencies.

Coordination. The Task Force is hereby authorized to enlist the assistance
of any branch, department, bureau, office, agency or instrumentality of the Government,
including government-owned and/or controlled corporations, in the performance of its
official functions.

Command and Control. The line of command and control of the Task
Force is as follows:
The Task Force Commander shall report and be directly responsible to
the President.
The Task Force Commander shall have the direct responsibility,
supervision and control over all component forces of the Task Force. He
is hereby authorized to select and designate all the personnel who will
work under him.
The component forces/elements from the NBI, PNP, DOJ, NICA and
AFP Service Counterintelligence Units must be attached and assigned

3
to the Task Force, i.e., their respective mother units shall provide/assign
a permanent force to the Task Force. The component force so attached
and assigned shall hold office or report to the Task Force Headquarters
daily. The Task Force Commander shall have directive and supervisory
authority over them.
Each component force shall have a designated Commander who shall
directly be responsible for his unit. He shall report and receive orders
directly from the Task Force Commander.

Powers and Functions. The Task Force shall have the following powers
and functions:
Conduct intelligence and counterintelligence operations to detect and
identify active and former military and police personnel and their
cohorts involved in criminal activities.
Cause or direct the immediate arrest, investigation and speedy
prosecution of such military and police personnel and their cohorts in
accordance with constitutional processes.
Refer the cases at hand, as the Task Force may deem proper and
necessary, in the interest of efficient and expeditious dispensation of
criminal justice, to the Presidential Anti-Crime Commission (PACC
and/or other appropriate law enforcement agency or prosecution office,
for investigation or prosecution, as the case may be.
Monitor the progress of on-going investigation and prosecution of cases
taken cognizance of wy the Task Force.
Recommend appropriate anti-crime issuances and legislations to the
President, PACC and Congress.
Conduct other special anti-crime operations as the President may direct.

Duties and Tasks. The Personnel and component units of the Task Force
shall perform the following duties and tasks:
Task Force Commander. Principally responsible for the successful
implementation of Task Force mission and functions, directs and
supervises the overall conduct of Task Force operations and perform
such other functions as the President may direct.
Deputy Task Force Commander for Intelligence/Operations.
Assists and advises the Task Force Commander on matters pertaining
to intelligence/operations.

Other Components. Conduct case buildup and counteraction

1. Regional Task Groups (RTG's). Conduct case buildup, counteraction
operations and prosecution of targeted criminal syndicates in their
respective AORs.

Operating Guidelines. In the implementation of this Executive Order, the
Task Force must follow the following guidelines:
The Task Force shall focus its efforts primarily against scalawags in the
AFP and other law enforcement agencies, or their former members,
involved in criminal activities although in the process, the Task Force
can initiate neutralization measures against their associated and
accomplices in these crime syndicates.
'The destruction of organized big-time criminal groups/syndicates
involving military, police and former military, or police personnel shall
be the operational priority of the Task Force. Along this line, it shall
direct its efforts against the following criminal activities.
Kidnap for Ransom

All operations conducted shall have prior clearance and knowledge of the
Task Force Commander. The Intelligence and Operation Officer shall
closely monitor and supervise the conduct of the operation.
On orders/instructions of the Task Force Commander, component forces
may operate either independently or jointly depending on the nature of
the target and operational necessity or practicality.
Respective component forces will be given the first opportunity to conduct
investigation/case build-up of identified scalawags in their respective
units/agencies.
Counteraction operations conducted against target personalities are
primarily aimed at bringing the suspects to the bar of justice for
successful prosecution.

Funding. The Task Force shall be provided with an initial
allocation of TWENTY MILLION PESOS (P20,000,000) to be drawn from the Office
of the President's contingency fund and/or from the government's savings for CY
1995, and such amount as may be approved by the President to be drawn from the
Contingency Fund for CY 1996, thereafter to be included in the annual budget of the
government.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 16th day of October in the year of Our Lord,
Nineteen Hundred and Ninety-Five.
By the President:
RUBEN D. TORRES
Executive Secretary
